Options specific to device `airscan:e0:HP ENVY 6400 series [03755A]':
  Standard:
    --resolution 75|100|150|200|300dpi [300]
        Sets the resolution of the scanned image.
    --mode Color|Gray [Color]
        Selects the scan mode (e.g., lineart, monochrome, or color).
    --scan-intent *unset*|Document|Text and Graphic|Photo|Preview [*unset*]
        Optimize scan for Text/Photo/etc.
    --source Flatbed|ADF [ADF]
        Selects the scan source (such as a document-feeder).
  Geometry:
    -l 0..215.9mm [0]
        Top-left x position of scan area.
    -t 0..297.011mm [0]
        Top-left y position of scan area.
    -x 0..215.9mm [215.9]
        Width of scan-area.
    -y 0..297.011mm [297.011]
        Height of scan-area.
  Enhancement:
    --brightness -100..100% (in steps of 1) [0]
        Controls the brightness of the acquired image.
    --contrast -100..100% (in steps of 1) [0]
        Controls the contrast of the acquired image.
    --shadow 0..100% (in steps of 1) [0]
        Selects what radiance level should be considered "black".
    --highlight 0..100% (in steps of 1) [100]
        Selects what radiance level should be considered "white".
    --analog-gamma 0.0999908..4 [1]
        Analog gamma-correction
    --negative[=(yes|no)] [no]
        Swap black and white
